name: Raxio DRC1 (Raxio Kinshasa)
notes: Carrier-neutral Tier III colocation inaugurated 2024 (US$30m), Limete industriel, 12eme Rue 9/11, Kinshasa. 1,056-1,542 m2 white space, up to 400 racks, 1.5 MW IT power (operator datasheet A; CAF/WAM trade corroboration B). 33 kV utility feed, fuel backup. Uptime Institute DRC1 record exists. GUPEC/ARE permit not surfaced in this pass - noted as missing official permit evidence.

name: OADC Texaf Kinshasa Data Centre (FIH1)
notes: First live Tier III Uptime-certified open-access carrier-neutral DC in DRC; went live 13 Aug 2024 at SILIKIN Village, Concession COTEX, Avenue Colonel Mondjiba, Kinshasa (Ngaliema commune). ~1,000 m2 technical space, N+1 cooling, 2 MW site load (site load, not IT load), 22 kV supply with 11 kV distribution; initial 400 m2 IT white space, future 550+ racks. Also hosts KINIX/ACIX exchange nodes per PeeringDB/DE-CIX.

name: Orange Business RDC datacenter hosting
notes: Official Orange Business RDC service page offers enterprise datacenter hosting / rack space with protected AC/DC power, optional link to Orange RDC datacenter, 24/7/365 support and SLA language. Facility address and MW capacity not public (likely Kinshasa). Operator service evidence only; no public MW/address.

name: Fastnet Kinshasa data center
notes: Fastnet operator announcement (2017) refers to its 'existing data center in Kinshasa' when announcing expansion to Lubumbashi and Goma. No public address or capacity for the Kinshasa facility; keep as lead pending ARPTC/PeeringDB corroboration.

name: GBS Datacenter (Kinshasa)
notes: Official GBS hosting page states GBS operates two data centers in Kinshasa and Lubumbashi with shared hosting (U/rack), dedicated bays and spaces. Directories list GBS Datacenter at 4630 avenue de la Science (DataCenterMap) or 769 Avenue de l'Equateur (Inflect) - address conflict unresolved. ARPTC licensed ISP; KINIX member. Capacity not public.

name: United S.A. hosting (Kinshasa)
notes: United offers hosting/fiber services, office at 165 Batetela Avenue, Kinshasa (ARPTC licensed ISP, KINIX member). Facility-level colocation/white-space evidence not confirmed in this pass; C-grade lead until official facility page or PeeringDB facility record appears.

name: Fastnet Lubumbashi Data Center
notes: Opened 2017 at the ESNAP teleport, Lubumbashi; 50 racks, direct international fibre connectivity, aimed at the southern DRC mining region (KINIX/Lubumbashi IXP ecosystem). Operator page self-claim (A) plus DCD trade coverage (B). Small facility; current operating status should be re-verified.

name: GBS Datacenter (Lubumbashi)
notes: GBS official hosting page: 'two data centers located in Kinshasa and Lubumbashi'. No public address/capacity for the Lubumbashi site; recorded as a lead based on the operator statement.
